issues.description: The problem statement and template instruct students to initialize the Farm's ArrayList in a no-argument constructor (public Farm()), but the solution implements only a constructor with an int parameter (public Farm(int initialCapacity)). This constructor parameter mismatch means the canonical solution does not provide the no-arg constructor students are asked to implement and the commented example in Main (new Farm()) in the template/problem would not match the solution's API.
issues.suggestedFix: Provide a no-argument constructor in the solution (e.g. public Farm() { this.animals = new ArrayList<>(); }) or include both constructors (no-arg and Farm(int initialCapacity)). Alternatively, update the problem statement and template to require a constructor with an int parameter if that was intended.
